def next_permutation(nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    # Find the longest non-increasing suffix
    i = len(nums) - 2
    while i >= 0 and nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]:
        i -= 1
    
    # If the entire array is non-increasing, reverse it to get the smallest permutation
    if i == -1:
        return nums[::-1]
    
    # Find the rightmost successor to pivot in the suffix
    j = len(nums) - 1
    while nums[j] <= nums[i]:
        j -= 1
    
    # Swap the pivot with its successor
    nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
    
    # Reverse the suffix starting at i+1
    nums[i + 1:] = reversed(nums[i + 1:])
    
    return nums

# Test cases
print(next_permutation([1, 2, 3]))  # [1, 3, 2]
print(next_permutation([3, 2, 1]))  # [1, 2, 3]
print(next_permutation([1, 5, 8, 4, 7, 6, 5, 3, 1]))  # [1, 5, 8, 5, 1, 3, 4, 6, 7]
print(next_permutation([1, 3, 2]))  # [2, 1, 3]
```
